text:
tanya-s: FYI candidate (Aisha Rahman) messaged she needs to pick up her child from daycare unexpectedly; ETA now 13:40 for a 09:30-16:00 onsite loop. She asked if we can consolidate interviews and/or offer a remote-first morning.

leo-m: Which slots are must-be-in-person? I'm flexible on the 15:00 culture chat but the 14:00 bar raiser prefers onsite.

recruiter-bot: Candidate profile: Aisha Rahman, needs lactation room access, dietary: halal, childcare_note: needs early pickup. Contact aisha.r@example.com.

tanya-s: Proposal: 1) Move technical deep-dive to 13:30 2) Keep bar-raiser at 14:00 onsite 3) Run morning hiring manager + peer chats remote 4) Reserve Lactation Room E 12:30-16:30 and Quiet Room F 13:00-15:00. Offer childcare subsidy up to $80 if she needs daycare pickup help.

calendar-bot: Backup Meet links created for 09:30 and 11:00: https://meet.google.com/aisha-backup. Updated calendar invites with note: "Candidate may pivot to remote. Join via backup link if invited." Reserved Lactation Room E 12:30-16:30 and Quiet Room F 13:00-15:00.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor prereg complete for "Aisha Rahman". Parking permit code emailed. Reception to provide pamphlet with lactation room location and halal lunch options.

facilities: Lactation Room E cleaned and stocked; baby-change station confirmed. Halal boxed lunch on hold (labelled: "Aisha R"). Quiet Room F has noise-damp panels available.

leo-m: I can take the tech deep-dive at 13:30. Bar-raiser confirmed onsite 14:00 — team please be ready for an in-person debrief.

tanya-s: I'll send candidate message and panel note. Template below (posting in thread):

```
Candidate message:
Hi Aisha 1: Sorry to hear about the daycare issue. We can run your morning interviews remotely using this Meet link: https://meet.google.com/aisha-backup and keep the afternoon bar-raiser onsite at 14:00. We've reserved Lactation Room E and Quiet Room F if you need a private space. If pickup costs are needed we can offer up to $80 childcare subsidy (email receipts to hr@redwood.ai). Halal lunch will be available. Please let us know your preference.

Panel message:
Team 1: Candidate may need to pivot to remote for the morning. Backup Meet links added to calendar. Lactation Room E and Quiet Room F reserved; halal lunch ordered. Please be prepared to run 09:30 and 11:00 remotely and aim to be onsite for the 14:00 bar-raiser. Contact Tanya (x512) with any changes.
```

recruiter-bot: Candidate replied at 08:10: "Thank you — remote morning works, I'll plan to be onsite for 14:00 and appreciate the lactation room"

frontdesk-bot: Badge printed and on-hold at reception for "Aisha Rahman".

leo-m: Thanks all 1: I'll take the 13:30 slot and be ready for hybrid tech setup.

tanya-s: Update: candidate arrived 13:20, used Quiet Room F to prep, tech deep-dive at 13:30 was onsite, bar-raiser at 14:00 completed in-person. Childcare subsidy not needed. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
